attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Adds custom RouteEndpoint caching for link generation across Autoroute/Sitemap/HomeRoute schemes with a hand-rolled RouteEndpointKey equality/hash implementation, and the HomeRoute variant updates two instance fields without locking, risking a subtle race under concurrent requests returning a mismatched cached endpoint/key pair."}

reason: Adds custom RouteEndpoint caching for link generation across Autoroute/Sitemap/HomeRoute schemes with a hand-rolled RouteEndpointKey equality/hash implementation, and the HomeRoute variant updates two instance fields without locking, risking a subtle race under concurrent requests returning a mismatched cached endpoint/key pair.
